title: Raheem Morris confirms Nick Bosa will play season opener
game: San Francisco 49ers at Los Angeles Rams
materialFindings: 49ers defensive coordinator Raheem Morris explicitly confirmed that Nick Bosa will play against the Rams.

The confirmation resolves the prior practice-participation uncertainty but does not imply a full workload or 100% effectiveness; Bosa has been managing tendinitis in his surgically repaired right knee.
No side, moneyline, total, prop, score prediction, or conviction statement was published or inferred.
